response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with a strong track record in full-stack, low-latency, and developer-tooling work, plus rare direct exposure to IDE internals (C/C++ components for NI LabWindows/CVI) and a genuine tooling mindset (test runners, assertion libraries, DevEx work). However, the role's core requirements — deep Java and Kotlin expertise, JVM internals, and solid Spring/Quarkus/Hibernate experience — are essentially absent. Java appears only peripherally (robotic arms, device orchestration ~2016-2018) and Kotlin and Spring are not mentioned at all; the last decade is dominated by TypeScript/Node and DLang. The gap to a flagship enterprise JVM IDE product is too large for a mid-senior IC expected to own enterprise-framework subsystems end to end.
strengths: Rare hands-on IDE/developer-tooling experience (LabWindows/CVI, test runners, MCP generators)
Deep systems and performance work (low-latency DLang microservices at massive scale)
Strong craftsmanship culture: TDD, CI/CD, pairing, teaching and public speaking
concerns: No demonstrated Kotlin or Spring/Quarkus/Hibernate experience
Java exposure is dated and shallow; no evidence of deep JVM understanding
Recent decade focused on TypeScript/Node and DLang, not enterprise JVM ecosystems
